en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard-style photograph showing a column of uniformed cavalry soldiers riding horses down a street lined with European-style houses. The soldiers carry long lances with pennant flags. In the background are stucco buildings with tiled roofs and a walled property with a small pavilion. A hanging sign on the right side of the image reads "Wagenbach" and some smaller text below. Civilians stand by the wall watching the procession.
